aboutPage.title: About EasymatchBD
aboutPage.intro: EasymatchBD is a Bangladesh-focused matrimonial platform built for serious marriage search — with verification, progressive privacy, and family-friendly values.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.body: We help individuals and families explore matrimonial compatibility with respect and transparency. Public browse stays anonymous; deeper biodata and photos unlock only through mutual consent.

verification.title: Verified profiles
verification.body: Members submit identity and biodata for review. Verified profiles carry a badge so families can search with greater confidence.

families.title: Built for families
families.body: EasymatchBD supports a respectful, structured process — from discovery and interest to messaging, video calls, and biodata sharing at higher privacy levels.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: Your privacy is central to EasymatchBD. This summary explains how information is shared on the platform. For full legal terms, see our Terms & Conditions.
privacyPage.fieldsCta: See which fields unlock at each level

overview.title: Progressive disclosure
overview.body: We do not show photos or contact details in public browse. Members reveal more biodata step by step as both sides agree to move forward together.

levels.title: Privacy levels
levels.body: Connections progress through four stages — from public discovery (level 0) to serious marriage consideration (level 3). Each stage unlocks additional fields according to platform rules and mutual consent.

photos.title: Photos & contact
photos.body: Profile photos and sensitive contact information are never shown publicly. They become available only after mutual interest and appropriate privacy progression.

control.title: Your control
control.body: Both members must agree to increase privacy levels. You can sign out at any time. For account or data questions, contact us via WhatsApp or the Contact page.

refundPage.title: Refund Policy
refundPage.intro: This policy explains how EasymatchBD handles membership payments and refund requests. We want you to feel confident when upgrading your account. If you change your mind shortly after purchase, we intend to honor a full refund when you ask within two days.

twoDayGuarantee.title: Full refund within 2 days
twoDayGuarantee.body: If you request a full refund within 2 calendar days (48 hours) of your purchase, we will honor it. This applies to qualifying membership and paid service purchases made directly through EasymatchBD, provided the request is submitted within the window.

scope.title: What this applies to
scope.body: This policy covers membership plan fees and paid consultant services purchased on the platform. Promotional offers, third-party billing arrangements, or payments processed outside EasymatchBD may follow different rules, which will be stated at checkout where applicable.

howToRequest.title: How to request a refund
howToRequest.body: Contact us through the Contact page, WhatsApp support, or the email address listed in the site footer. Include your account email or phone number, the purchase date, and your payment reference or receipt if you have one. We will confirm receipt and guide you through the next steps.

processing.title: Refund processing
processing.body: Approved refunds are returned to your original payment method whenever possible. Processing usually takes 5–10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider. Once processed, paid membership access tied to that purchase will end.

afterWindow.title: Requests after 2 days
afterWindow.body: Refund requests received more than 2 days after purchase are reviewed case by case. We may decline refunds where membership benefits have already been substantially used, except where required by applicable law. We may update this policy from time to time; the version on this page applies to new purchases after it is published.

contactPage.title: Contact us
contactPage.intro: Questions about browsing, verification, membership, or privacy? Reach our team using the options below.
contactPage.whatsappBody: Fastest way to reach EasymatchBD support — account help, verification, and general questions.

contactPage.emailBody: Send us a message and we will respond as soon as possible.
contactPage.supportBody: Use the WhatsApp button on the site for the quickest response from our team.
contactPage.hoursBody: We aim to respond to WhatsApp messages within business hours (Sunday–Thursday, Bangladesh time). Messages outside hours are answered on the next working day.

privacyFieldsPage.title: Data shared at each privacy level
privacyFieldsPage.intro: EasymatchBD reveals biodata step by step as both members agree to move forward. This page shows which profile fields become visible at each level, based on the platform's current privacy rules.
privacyFieldsPage.cumulativeNote: Privacy is cumulative — Level 2 includes everything from Level 1, Level 3 includes Level 2, and so on. Fields highlighted in green are newly unlocked at that level.

faq.subtitle: Quick answers about browsing, privacy, and membership.

browse.question: Can I browse biodata without signing in?
browse.answer: Yes. Public browse shows verified profiles with level 0 fields only. No photos or contact details are shown without signing in and connecting.

photos.question: When can I see photos?
photos.answer: Photos are not shown in public browse. They unlock after mutual interest and as both members increase their connection privacy level.

membership.question: What does paid membership include?
membership.answer: Paid membership unlocks expressing interest, messaging, video calls, biodata PDF export, and other connection features. Browsing and profile creation remain free.

verification.question: How does verification work?
verification.answer: Members submit identity and biodata for review. Verified profiles appear in discovery and public browse with a verified badge.

privacy.question: Who controls what information is shared?
privacy.answer: Both members control privacy progression together. Neither side can unilaterally access photos or deeper biodata without mutual consent at each stage.
